name: serpkite
label: SerpKite
description: Search and public web content for automation.

modules.name: searchSearch
modules.label: Search web results
modules.description: Returns Google web results for a query, one bundle per organic result.

modules.name: searchNews
modules.label: Search news articles
modules.description: Returns Google News articles for a query.

modules.name: searchImages
modules.label: Search images
modules.description: Returns Google Images results for a query.

modules.name: searchVideos
modules.label: Search videos
modules.description: Returns Google video results for a query.

modules.name: searchMaps
modules.label: Search Google Maps places
modules.description: Returns places from a Google Maps search, with address, coordinates, rating, opening hours and place IDs.

modules.name: searchShopping
modules.label: Search products
modules.description: Returns Google Shopping product results for a query.

modules.name: searchScholar
modules.label: Search papers
modules.description: Returns Google Scholar results for a query.

modules.name: searchPatents
modules.label: Search patents
modules.description: Returns Google Patents results for a query.

modules.name: searchAutocomplete
modules.label: Get query suggestions
modules.description: Returns Google autocomplete suggestions for a query.

modules.name: getAccount
modules.label: Get account balance
modules.description: Returns the credit balance, rate limit, monthly usage and limits of the account and API key.

modules.name: fetchWebpage
modules.label: Fetch a webpage
modules.description: Returns a public web page or PDF as Markdown and plain text, with its metadata.

modules.name: askChatgpt
modules.label: Ask ChatGPT
modules.description: Asks ChatGPT as a logged-out visitor and returns its answer with the sources it cited, the products and places it showed and the model it used. Takes 10–30 s.

modules.name: askGemini
modules.label: Ask Gemini
modules.description: Asks Google Gemini as a logged-out visitor and returns its answer with the sources it grounded on. Takes 5–30 s.

modules.name: askCopilot
modules.label: Ask Copilot Search
modules.description: Asks Microsoft Copilot Search as a logged-out visitor and returns its answer with its cited sources and the products shown beside it. Takes 15–40 s.

modules.name: askAiMode
modules.label: Ask Google AI Mode
modules.description: Asks Google AI Mode as a logged-out visitor and returns its answer with the sources it cited. Takes 5–45 s.

modules.name: askBraveAi
modules.label: Ask Brave AI
modules.description: Asks Brave Search's AI answer as a logged-out visitor and returns its answer with its cited sources, the searches it ran and the products it showed. Takes 1–10 s.

modules.name: getPlace
modules.label: Get place details
modules.description: Returns one Google Maps place's full listing: address, coordinates, categories, opening hours per weekday, website, phone, rating, description and photos.

modules.name: listReviews
modules.label: List place reviews
modules.description: Returns a Google Maps place's most relevant reviews with rating, date, text, reviewer and the owner's response.

modules.name: listSiteUrls
modules.label: List site URLs
modules.description: Returns the URLs of a site from its sitemaps and start page, optionally ranked by a search phrase.

modules.name: extractWebpages
modules.label: Extract webpages
modules.description: Returns up to 20 pages or PDFs as Markdown with metadata, optionally with passages ranked by a query and an AI summary per page.

modules.name: startCrawl
modules.label: Start a crawl
modules.description: Starts reading a site in the background. Get the pages with Get a crawl, or receive them on a webhook.

modules.name: getCrawl
modules.label: Get a crawl
modules.description: Returns a crawl's status, progress and, once it has completed, its pages as Markdown. Crawls are kept for 24 hours.

modules.name: getAnswer
modules.label: Get a cited answer
modules.description: Answers a question from live Google results and returns the answer with numbered citations and the results it used.

modules.name: makeAnApiCall
modules.label: Make an API call
modules.description: Performs an arbitrary authorized API call.

status: prepared locally; not deployed or scenario-tested
